● 根因结论（先给答案，再给证据）
这不是 bug，是模型命名理解的偏差 —— gemini-3-pro-thinking 在 Google 那边根本不存在。
关键事实
1. Gemini 当前版本是 "3 Pro"，不是 "3.1 Pro" —— Google 没发过 3.1
这个版本号（你记忆里写的"gemini3.1pro"，结合你之前提过的语音输入习惯，多半是把 "3 Pro" 听写成 "3.1 Pro"）。
2. Gemini 3 Pro 本身就是 thinking 模型。底层 gemini-webapi v2.0.0 的 Model 枚举 (constants.py:95-141) 里所有 Pro 变体只有这三个：
- gemini-3-pro (基础)
- gemini-3-pro-plus (需 Plus 订阅)
- gemini-3-pro-advanced (需 Advanced 订阅)

screen_text.text:
没有任何 pro-thinking 后缀的模型。-thinking 这个后缀只用于 Flash (gemini-3-flash-thinking)，因为 Flash 默认不思考，需要独立模型 ID 切到思考模式；Pro 默认就思考，所以不需要单独 ID。
3. 反代后端 /v1/models 实测返回（已 curl 验证）：
gemini-3-flash
gemini-3-flash-thinking
gemini-3-pro
3. 没出现 pro-plus / pro-advanced，说明你这个 Google 账号没有 Gemini Advanced/Plus 订阅（不是反代过滤的，是 Google 服务端没订同返回的）。
4. 网页端"思考"开关 vs API：网页端 Pro 上的"显示思考过程"是 UI 层面...模型 ID 始终是 gemini-3-pro，思考能力是模型 native 的。
你看正可能在同的事

segments.action: I ride a yellow shared bicycle along the paved sidewalk toward an upcoming street intersection while looking at the path ahead.
segments.action_brief: I ride a shared bicycle.
segments.environment:
Physical space: An outdoor urban sidewalk paved with rectangular brick tiles at night, illuminated warmly by overhead streetlamps. To the left is a roadway bordered by low hedge bushes. To the right along the curb is a designated parking row of yellow and green shared bicycles. Ahead is a wide multi-lane intersection with overhead traffic signals and distant high-rise residential towers showing scattered window lights. A companion rides alongside on another yellow shared bicycle on the left.
Objects: Yellow shared bicycle handlebars and front wire basket in my grip; row of parked shared bicycles on the right; metal streetlight pole with glowing lamps; red fire hydrant on the right sidewalk.
Screen content: None.
Text in the world: None visible.
Media playing: None.
Ambient audio: Nighttime city ambience, bicycle tire rolling sounds, distant traffic hum.
segments.details: I hold both handlebars with my hands and look at the tactile paving and sidewalk path extending forward.

segments.action: I continue pedaling toward the corner of the intersection and observe the roadway ahead as my companion cycles forward onto the pedestrian crossing area.
segments.action_brief: I approach the intersection corner.
segments.environment: My companion on the yellow bicycle advances ahead to the left towards the pedestrian crossing; the sidewalk opens up directly to the wide road intersection.
segments.details: I look slightly to the left toward the road intersection as my companion pedals past.

segments.action: I slow down and stop my bicycle at the sidewalk curb next to a cylindrical bollard, looking down at the zebra crossing markings on the asphalt.
segments.action_brief: I stop my bicycle at the crosswalk curb.
segments.environment: I stop at the corner curb where a short cylindrical bollard and a street storm drain grate mark the edge of the sidewalk before the painted zebra crosswalk.
segments.details: I gaze downward at the road drain and white crosswalk stripes directly in front of the front wheel.

segments.action: I look up across the intersection and observe traffic, watching a transit bus with glowing green interior lights and passenger cars drive through.
segments.action_brief: I watch traffic passing through the intersection.
segments.environment: A green-lit city bus and cars drive across the multi-lane intersection from right to left with their headlights casting beams onto the asphalt.
segments.details: I track the moving bus and cars across the intersection.

segments.action: I look at the traffic light pole to my left, noting the pedestrian red light countdown timer counting down from 57 to 52 while a white sedan drives through the crosswalk area.
segments.action_brief: I check the red pedestrian countdown signal.
segments.environment: The pedestrian signal on the post to the left displays a red standing figure with a digital countdown display ticking from '57' down to '52'; a white car with bright headlights passes across the crosswalk lanes.
segments.details: I look at the pedestrian light countdown and then track the white car as it passes directly in front of the crosswalk.

segments.action: I scan ahead across the intersection towards the far side of the road where the bus pulls away near illuminated storefronts.
segments.action_brief: I scan the intersection.
segments.environment: The roadway directly in front clears of moving cars; the bus moves along the far right side near streetlamps and illuminated shop signage.
segments.details: I look straight across the empty crosswalk stripes into the open intersection.
